title.en: Validate a household context and the roles file, and hash the context

goal.en: Check the example HouseholdContext and the RecipientRoles file with the validate tool, hash the context so a local log can refer to it, and see the same document fail when checked as a recipe.

note.en: Validate the example household context against the household schema. The reference hub's validate checks the document against the schema file's root; this schema keeps its kinds under $defs, so today this call reports ok for any document, and `cookwala validate` (the CLI line) is the real check.
Hash the context: sha256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON, the same hash in every language.
The same document checked as a recipe fails with twelve errors: kinds are not interchangeable.
The recipient roles file is a household-profile document too.

outcome.en: You can check and hash household documents from any language. The hash never leaves the home either; it is for the local incident memory. Next: 088 compares three roles side by side.
